title: Advancements of anticancer agents by targeting the Hippo signalling pathway: biological activity, selectivity, docking analysis, and structure-activity relationship.
authors: Haripriya, E; Hemalatha, K; Matada, Gurubasavaraja Swamy Purawarga; Pal, Rohit; Das, Pronoy Kanti; Ashadul Sk, M D; Mounika, S; Viji, M P; Aayishamma, I; Jayashree, K R
one_liner_zh: 综述Hippo通路YAP/TAZ-TEAD互作及其抑制剂，含对接分析和构效关系，但核心是药物研发而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: The Hippo signalling pathway is prominent and governs cell proliferation and stem cell activity, acting as a growth regulator and tumour suppressor. Defects in Hippo signalling and hyperactivation of its downstream effector's Yes-associated protein (YAP) and transcriptional co-activator with PDZ-binding motif (TAZ) play roles in cancer development, implying that pharmacological inhibition of YAP and TAZ activity could be an effective cancer treatment strategy. Conversely, YAP and TAZ can also have beneficial effects in promoting tissue repair and regeneration following damage, therefore their activation may be therapeutically effective in certain instances. Recently, a complex network of intracellular and extracellular signalling mechanisms that affect YAP and TAZ activity has been uncovered. The YAP/TAZ-TEAD interaction leads to tumour development and the protein structure of YAP/TAZ-TEAD includes three interfaces and one hydrophobic pocket. There are clinical and preclinical trial drugs available to inhibit the hippo signalling pathway, but these drugs have moderate to severe side effects, so researchers are in search of novel, potent, and selective hippo signalling pathway inhibitors. In this review, we have discussed the hippo pathway in detail, including its structure, activation, and role in cancer. We have also provided the various inhibitors under clinical and preclinical trials, and advancement of small molecules their detailed docking analysis, structure-activity relationship, and biological activity. We anticipate that the current study will be a helpful resource for researchers.
abstract_zh: Hippo信号通路显著，调控细胞增殖和干细胞活性，作为生长调节因子和肿瘤抑制因子发挥作用。Hippo信号传导的缺陷及其下游效应因子Yes相关蛋白（YAP）和含PDZ结合基序的转录共激活因子（TAZ）的过度激活在癌症发展中起作用，暗示对YAP和TAZ活性的药理学抑制可能是一种有效的癌症治疗策略。相反，YAP和TAZ在损伤后促进组织修复和再生方面也可能具有有益效果，因此在某些情况下，它们的激活可能在治疗上有效。近年来，已揭示了一个影响YAP和TAZ活性的复杂细胞内和细胞外信号传导机制网络。YAP/TAZ-TEAD相互作用导致肿瘤发展，YAP/TAZ-TEAD的蛋白质结构包含三个界面和一个疏水口袋。目前有临床和临床前试验药物可抑制Hippo信号通路，但这些药物具有中度至重度副作用，因此研究人员正在寻找新型、有效且选择性的Hippo信号通路抑制剂。在本综述中，我们详细讨论了Hippo通路，包括其结构、激活及其在癌症中的作用。我们还提供了处于临床和临床前试验中的各种抑制剂，以及小分子的进展，包括其详细的对接分析、构效关系和生物活性。我们预计当前研究将对研究人员有所帮助。
